title: PMMA Spin-coating
author: Kenneth Schackart
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yaefsbe

steps.title: Clean cover slip
steps.instruction: Wipe the cover slip with 70% ethanol using a delicate task wipe.

steps.title: Prepare cover slip for spin coating
steps.instruction: Place the cover slip into the spin coater, centering it with the square in the spin coater.

steps.title: Dispense PMMA solution
steps.instruction: Dispense 30 µL of PMMA solution onto the center of the cover slip.

steps.title: Spin-coat the cover slip
steps.instruction: Spin the cover slip for 00:00:30 at 2000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Note: Higher angular velocities will form thinner coatings.

steps.title: Remove cover slip
steps.instruction: Carefully remove the cover slip from the spin coater using tweezers.

steps.title: Bake cover slip
steps.instruction: Place the cover slip onto a 180 °C hot plate for 00:01:00.
